compute_det2x2: compute the determinant of a batch of 2x2 matrices using the det2x2 function
compute_trace2x2: compute the trace of a batch of 2x2 matrices using the trace2x2 function
invert_2x2_matrices: invert a batch of 2x2 matrices and return inverses with determinants using inv2x2
compute_cholesky_2x2: compute the Cholesky decomposition of 2x2 matrices with upper or lower triangular output using cholesky2x2
compute_chol_log_det: compute the log determinant of a Cholesky factor matrix using chol_log_det
